0.original: Yoenne wants you to check on the researchers surveying the ruins at Issom<hex:021F0103>Har.

1.original: The researchers surveying the ruins at Issom<hex:021F0103>Har are overdue for their regular visit to Buscarron's Druthers. Head south to the nearby ruins, and look for the researcher known as Irielle.

2.original: The unsuspecting victims of a swarm of chigoes, Irielle and her colleague had until recently been locked in a battle for their own survival. Though thankfully none the worse for the ordeal, Irielle asks that you discourage any further such attacks by summarily slaying five of the brood.

3.original: You have exterminated the meddling chigoes and sent the rest of the brood scuttling back into the shadowy depths. Inform Irielle at Issom<hex:021F0103>Har of your deeds.

4.original: Irielle and her colleague can now continue their survey, free of the insect menace. Report your success to Yoenne at Buscarron's Druthers.

5.original: Yoenne is relieved to hear of her customers' safety, though at the same time disavowing all knowledge of Irielle's brother, or why she would be concerned with his safety.

25.original: Examine the strange shadow and slay chigoes.

48.original: Hail, friend! Would you fancy a flagon of ale, or perhaps─ah, an adventurer! I can scarce believe my fortune. I was just looking for someone who might assist me in checking on the welfare of a couple of regulars.

49.original: To be precise, I'm looking for an expedition team poking around in the ruins of Issom<hex:021F0103>Har, due south of here. They usually turn up at the Druthers every few days, covered in dust and hungering for a hot meal, but they've not been in for nigh on a week.

50.original: Could well be that they're simply occupied with scholarly business, but they'd be running low on supplies by now, and that concerns me. Please, pay them a visit at the ruins and see if aught's amiss. You're looking for one by the name of “Irielle,” by the way. I...ah...forget the other one's name.

51.original: Yes, may I help you with something? Ah, Yoenne was concerned for our well-being? How positively sweet of her, but as you can see, we are both quite hale and decidedly not deceased.

52.original: We did, however, encounter certain practical difficulties when a veritable legion of chigoes burst forth from the depths of the pit. Your timing is impeccable, as we have only just succeeded in clambering out.

53.original: In fact, since you are here, perhaps you might prevent a similar situation by slaughtering a number of the pests. Say, five or so? That should be sufficient to frighten the rest of the brood back to the shadows below.

55.original: My, my, that was marvelous work, adventurer. Many thanks. Perhaps now we might return to our research in relative peace.<hex:02100103>...Hm? Oh, the ruins you can see down there are part of the ancient subterranean city known as Gelmorra.

56.original: For Duskwight Elezen such as ourselves, it represents a valuable and unexpected opportunity to learn more about the settlement where our ancestors once dwelled.

57.original: Yet...as fascinating as the ruins are, I do believe I have had my fill of the inside of that hole for the time being. At any rate, you can assure Yoenne that the two of us─ahem, <hex:021A020203>particularly<hex:021A020103> my brother─are quite well, and will soon be along to partake in Buscarron's finest meat and mead.

58.original: Thank you, friend. Buscarron might come off as rough-hewn to strangers, but I tell you, he'd be right devastated were anything to happen to one of his regulars.

59.original: What's that? Irielle assures me that her <hex:021A020203>brother<hex:021A020103> is in fine fettle as well? Why, I...I have not the slightest idea of whom she speaks, nor why that would concern me! Hmph!

60.original: A swarm of chigoes bursts forth from the shadows!
